resolution.note: A force-exited test file now flushes its stdout pipe before exiting (scripts/lib/test-exit-flush.mjs preloaded by testCeilingArguments); test/ci/test-exit-flush.test.mjs fails without it

title: A passing shard never loses a per-file test summary
body:
Outcome: a Test shard never fails strict evidence when every test in it passed: the per-file summary of test/claude/successor-launch.test.ts is never "tests":0 in KRN_TEST_SUMMARY_JSON.
Why: three runs failed only on "Strict test evidence rejected: missing per-file summary: .../test/claude/successor-launch.test.ts" while the slowest-tests table shows its tests ran and passed: 42816958456 and 42805957550 (main) and 42846210958 attempt 1 (PR 583, green on rerun). Each costs a rerun; logs in .krn/tmp/ci-<id>.log.
Proof: a test at the summary layer (scripts/test-summary-policy.mjs or the reporter feeding it) reproduces the dropped per-file summary from a verbatim capture of the failing shard output and sees it counted; the 26 tests of the file pass.
Scope: scripts/test-summary-policy.mjs, scripts/test-suite.mjs, the test reporter, their tests.
